title: Page Tree (full document element tree + read/write envelope)
description: FROZEN shape of an Elementor document's element tree as the MCP reads and writes it. The wire form of _elementor_data is a JSON ARRAY of top-level ElementNodes (RESEARCH.md §2.1). Reads add a base_hash optimistic-lock token (md5 of the stored _elementor_data string) and a generation probe. TS type names: PageTree, PageTreeRead, PageTreeWrite (WP-F03). Persistence ALWAYS goes through Document::save(['elements','settings']) via the companion plugin (WP-P02); NEVER raw-write _elementor_data.

ElementsArray.description: Ordered array of top-level element nodes (the raw _elementor_data payload).

Generation.description: Authoring generation of the tree (or the per-node default). 'v4' = atomic primary; 'v3' = classic fallback. New pages default to v4 when atomic is active, else v3 (probe via elementor.site.capabilities).

PageSettings.description: Document/page settings (_elementor_page_settings). Free-form assoc map; partial updates use GET-merge-PUT in the plugin until save_settings merge semantics are confirmed (S4 / WP-S04).

PageTreeRead.description: Returned by elementor.page.get_structure. base_hash is the optimistic-lock token to echo back on writes.

base_hash.description: md5(_elementor_data) at read time. Echo back as base_hash on edit/replace_tree to detect lost updates. NOTE: base_hash does NOT reflect a pending autosave — also check autosave-status (RESEARCH.md §7).

used_ids.description: Optional: the set of element ids in use (for client-side dedupe before insert).

PageTreeWrite.description: Input to elementor.page.replace_tree / page.build. base_hash REQUIRED for replace_tree (optimistic lock); op_id enables idempotent replay. generation selects atomic vs classic emission.

post_id.description: Omit for page.build (creates new); required for replace_tree.

base_hash.description: Required for in-place tree replacement; the write fails with AUTOSAVE_CONFLICT/CONCURRENCY error if stale.

op_id.description: Idempotency key threaded TS->PHP->Document::save(). On replay the plugin detects + no-ops.

force.description: Override lock-held / newer-autosave guards (RESEARCH.md §7). Default false.
